teams.description: List of teams matching the request.

nextPageToken.description:
Cursor token for retrieving the next page of results.
 Empty string indicates this is the last page.

totalSize.description:
Total number of items matching the query across all pages.
 Optional - may be omitted if computing the total would be expensive
 (e.g., large datasets, complex filters, cross-shard queries).
 Clients MUST NOT assume this field will always be present.

description.description: Optional description explaining the team's purpose or scope

updatedAt.description: When this team was last modified

immutable.description: Whether this team is synchronized from your identity provider and cannot be modified directly

type.description: Distinguishes platform-managed teams (PREDEFINED) from teams you create (USERDEFINED)

users.description: Users who are members of this team.

email.description: Primary email address for authentication and contact

additionalEmails.description: Additional email addresses linked to user account

api.v4.User.description: A person that can access CloudBees Unify. Invite users to a tenant to grant them access to your organizations.
